headline: Cal State LA beat UC Merced again
dek: Cal State LA have beaten UC Merced in consecutive matches this month, after the sides drew in September, and are away to Concordia today. Cal Poly Pomona, beaten twice all season, face Western Washington after seeing off Simon Fraser.
displaced_by: Cal State LA beat UC Merced on 2026-11-13, so the dek's upcoming meeting has now been played, and Cal Poly Pomona have conceded seven, so the six-goal headline is no longer true
